scale: 1 = unusable or does not run, 2 = runs but most features missing, 3 = core generator works but several spec items missing, 4 = nearly all spec items present with minor gaps, 5 = every spec item present and polished

checks.text: The app installs, builds, and renders its home page without errors.
H1 'Color Palette Generator' and the specified subheading are visible above the fold.
Five large color cards are shown.
Seed color input with a native color picker and a HEX text input.
Harmony mode control offering Random, Monochromatic, Analogous, Complementary, Triadic, Tetradic, Pastel, Vibrant, Dark.
Each card has a lock/unlock control; 'Clear locks' exists.
Each card shows HEX, RGB, and HSL values with copy controls.
Each card shows best text color, contrast ratios against black and white, and a label (Good for text / Use carefully / Decorative only).
Export panel with CSS variables, Tailwind config, JSON, and SVG swatch strip.
'Save palette' plus a saved-palettes section to reopen and delete palettes.
Educational SEO content and an FAQ section below the tool.
Footer with Privacy and Terms links.
Clean, modern, polished visual design with palettes as the visual hero; responsive layout.
